note: Missouri River bottomland of marshes, fields and timber west of Craig, partly Corps mitigation land. MDC marks two primitive camping areas on Austin Road: a small camp with three gravel pull-in spurs near the marsh by the Annapalis Road end, and a spot beside the boat-ramp lot on the Missouri River at the road's end. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'; map (06/15) two Primitive Camping Area symbols = GIS 270 (river ramp lot, the pin) and 563 (camp with 3 gravel spurs, 1.9 km NE). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN is on the minor ramp-lot spot: main camp is 563, move to 40.18305,-95.44450, and then waterfront goes riverfront -> not waterfront. No split (shared Austin Rd). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map.' Map (06/15) legend 'Primitive Camping Area'; two symbols: at the Parking w/ Boat Launch lot at the end of Austin Rd on the Missouri River (= GIS 270, the pin) and by the lot near the Austin Rd / Annapalis Rd junction at the marsh (= GIS 563). Imagery: 563 is a mowed clearing with a short gravel loop and three gravel pull-in spurs ~15-20 m long under a few trees - a plain small campground, a 23-ft rig fits; 270 is under trees at the river bank just east of the ramp, and the drivable place is the gravel ramp lot 1314 (~25 x 60 m). Both are designated points, so both stay; no horse camp, ford or rig wording.

PIN / MAIN CAMP: stored 40.16895,-95.45714 = GIS 270, under trees at the water's edge beside the boat ramp; the drivable spot there is the ramp lot (40.16936,-95.45718). The clear main camp is GIS 563 with its three spurs: move the pin there, 40.18305,-95.44450.

WATERFRONT LEAD (riverfront): at the main camp (563) the Missouri River is ~1.6 km away; a marsh pool lies ~80 m NE behind brush - not waterfront. If the pin moves to the main camp, riverfront -> not waterfront. If the pin stays at the ramp spot: the camper parks on the ramp lot, whose south end meets the river only through the boat ramp (a used strip) with a wooded bank either side, so riverfront is not earned there either; riverview at most (the river, ~300 m wide, is plainly in sight from the lot's lower end).
CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: 270 and 563 are 1.9 km apart but both on Austin Rd from Annapalis Rd, one entrance road; no split. near.py: nothing else in campgrounds.json within 3 km of 563.
PHONE: area page 'For more information call (816) 271-3100' matches stored.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. The page lists Waterfowl Hunting / Open Hunting; no closure zones on the map.
